gen-gf-mate-fs-bespoke-sans: Bookish and sharp. Mate bends its strokes with a subtle swelling, while Bespoke Sans keeps its curves apart from the stem and reads lightly over a long stretch of text.
gen-gf-metamorphous-fs-karma: Metamorphous spreads its letters with a high-set midline and a soft fat-and-slim stroke, looking quietly commanding. Karma then reads smoothly, never snagging the eye.
gen-gf-metamorphous-fs-ranade: Commanding, a little strange. Metamorphous is built to stand out with its high midline, whereas Ranade is built for spread-out lines whose weight shifts only slightly.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-cossette-titre: Commanding, yes, but Metamorphous also carries slim crossbars and generous sidebearings. Cossette Titre answers in a sans-serif with open bowls and tight spacing, so its size can stay modest.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-syriac: Metamorphous leads with a high midline and soft accents of heavier strokes. Noto Sans Syriac follows in tall, rounded lowercase bowls like blown glass bulbs, with wide, easy turns that make a long passage feel approachable.
gen-gf-noto-sans-chakma-fs-erode: Dignified and editorial, the body text moves with a gentle ebb and flow in its weight. Erode has a tall middle band and broad openings on the g and a, so a long passage goes down smoothly.
gen-gf-noto-sans-display-fs-karma: Noto Sans Display lifts a soaring x-height into the headline and keeps its lines slim and modern. Karma does the quieter job, setting trustworthy text serif paragraphs with tempered thick-thin strokes that never turn into hairlines.
gen-gf-noto-sans-old-persian-fs-karma: A widely parted s and a hefty lowercase body give Noto Sans Old Persian its character. Karma follows with a classic serif finish, and its small gap between x-height and caps lets it sit comfortably at modest sizes.
gen-gf-noto-sans-syriac-western-fs-karma: Trustworthy and classic, Karma moves through text with terminals that finish well clear of the stem. Noto Sans Syriac Western is best at its tall body with short stems and open curve tips, while the text serif handles low-key thick-thin variation.
gen-gf-noto-serif-grantha-fs-asap: Stubby, bookish, and big in the middle. Noto Serif Grantha carries a large x-height and gently modulated strokes without sharp hairlines, beside Asap's open arcs. Its best quality is the way the two share tall lowercase.
